title: From federal SOCs to Talos: Ryan Fetterman on practical security research
description: This content is an interview and career retrospective with security researcher Ryan Fetterman, discussing his journey from federal security operations centers to his role at Cisco Talos. It covers his experiences with detection engineering, host-based analytics, and challenges faced during advanced persistent threat (APT) incident investigations. The discussion includes insights into evolving attacker tactics and the importance of sustainable career development in cybersecurity.
